scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @cyberbang/server && npm run build -w @cyberbang/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @cyberbang/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cyberbang/server && npm run typecheck -w @cyberbang/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @cyberbang/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npx concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @cyberbang/server" "npm run dev -w @cyberbang/client"
